## Critical Dependencies

1. Gate 1 evidence must precede credible staging commitment.
2. Staging and target-environment confirmation must precede production preparation.
3. The authentication and participant-data direction under `DEP-09 (Option B authentication and participant-data handling decision)` must precede participant use and access acceptance.
4. Participant creation or invitation must be resolved against the Gate 2 pass conditions.
5. Content supply under `DEP-03 (Media team supplies session video links)` must precede content readiness.
6. Production URL and infrastructure under `DEP-05 (Domain name availability and production URL)` must precede production deployment.
7. `DEP-07 (LeadLab Director final OK)` must precede launch acceptance.
